title: Music From the Films of Wes Anderson: How to Buy Tickets to the Live Concert Series Online
summary: Live from the Hollywood Bowl, the L.A. Philharmonic performs starting July 10 with special guests Beck, Karen O, Jenny Lewis and others.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

For the past 30 years, Wes Anderson has been making timeless and highly stylized films including The Royal Tenenbaums , The Grand Budapest Hotel , Rushmore and others. Now, the Los Angeles Philharmonic will celebrate his filmography with a three-night concert series at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles.

Under conductor Thomas Wilkins, with special guests Beck, Jenny Lewis, Jackson Browne, Jason Schwartzman, Karen O, Mark Mothersbaugh, Bill Murray and others, the orchestra will perform music from Anderson’s films starting July 10.

Although tickets for Music from the Films of Wes Anderson first went on sale through HollywoodBowl.com , the dates have either sold out or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find tickets online is through third-party sites.

Tickets are available at StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.
